text: Then $H_k$ is the Howell form of these rows in the columns $C_k$, and $\mathrm{NF}_k(u)$ for $u\notin S_k$ is $\pi_k(u)$ reduced by $H_k$, kept as matrices $T_k[p]$ (rows: non-standard words of degree $p$, columns: candidates of degree $\ge p$) for the prefix and suffix rules of level $k+1$. The truncation property is checked at every level (pivots and valuations below the top degree equal those of $H_{k-1}$).
